verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Reveal card details iOS SDK that lets cardholders see their PAN, CVC, and expiration date in-app, which is the kind of hosted/SDK reveal flow the story asks for. The evidence never states that this flow keeps the developer out of PCI scope or SAQ D, which is the story's core compliance requirement. Only an iOS variant is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation that the reveal flow removes PCI DSS/SAQ D scope, a description of the ephemeral-key or encryption mechanism, web and Android reveal components, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
